Help & Setup

Playing the game

The easiest way to play is in your browser — no install. Open the game in Chrome 121+, Edge 121+, or Brave with WebGPU enabled. Firefox and Safari aren't supported yet.

Native build (desktop)

Want more than the browser taster — optional sign-in, playing with friends over the internet, split-screen, cloud saves, world chat? Grab the free desktop app. Linux ships as a ready-to-run AppImage that updates itself; Windows and macOS aren't published as installers yet, so build from source instead. See the download page for both routes.

Controllers

Xbox and PlayStation controllers work via USB or Bluetooth. For split-screen, connect two controllers — the second one triggers Player 2 automatically.

Something not working?

Not sure your device can run it? Try the compatibility check. Alpha testers can report a bug or idea from the desktop app with /bug or /idea in game chat — it goes straight to the team. It is off by default: open Settings (top of the world list, or the pause menu) and tap the version line 7 times to switch it on. (The browser version has no feedback channel.)
